# Jammerbugt

Jammerbugt is a Danish municipality (kommune) mentioned once in the AFDK_2024 documentation as part of Klynge MIDT, one of the geographic health clusters participating in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark) [^src1]. The AFDK program is administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram and documents Indikator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse), covering structured patient education for atrial fibrillation based on European ESC guidelines and Danish national recommendations, including the ABC Pathway model for integrated atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. The chapter in which Jammerbugt appears provides a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the AFDK program, and Jammerbugt is listed as belonging to Klynge MIDT within that overview [^src1].

No further details, relationships, or claims about Jammerbugt are available in the corpus.
